description: Obligations whose dates a permit or rule sets (D-093), for Studio's calendar. Each names its source and the date someone read that source; change a date only from the source. level: the area level an obligation is listed at (municipality obligations also show for a town's tracts and block groups). Either a date or a yearly month and day. kit: the kit in catalog/kits.json that prepares for it; hazard_mitigation_kit does so for FEMA's plan expiration dates.

obligations.title: MS4 annual report and certification
obligations.note: Covers January 1 to December 31 of the year before, with the Supplemental Questionnaire; filed in NJDEP's Regulatory Services Portal.

source.label: NJPDES Tier A MS4 general permit NJ0141852, Part IV.K.1.d

obligations.title: Watershed assessment report
obligations.note: Phase 2 of the watershed improvement plan: water quality projects by subwatershed, estimated load reductions, costs and funding sources (EDPA + 48 months).

source.label: NJPDES Tier A MS4 general permit NJ0141852, Part IV.H.1.e

obligations.title: Final watershed improvement plan
obligations.note: Phase 3: projects, schedule, costs and funding. The plan is then carried out on its own schedule and updated, when needed, after each two-year review of the Integrated Report and new TMDLs (EDPA + 59 months; Part IV.H.1.h-i).

source.label: NJPDES Tier A MS4 general permit NJ0141852, Part IV.H.1.g

obligations.title: Tier A permit term ends
obligations.note: Authorizations renew automatically when NJDEP reissues the general permit; the next permit's terms are not yet published.

source.label: NJPDES Tier A MS4 general permit NJ0141852, authorization
